# FLX-2114: the run digest moved from the recorded golden baseline

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

KERNEL-SPEC section 10 records one golden baseline per simulation under `<state_dir>/golden/`, and `fluxsim verify` compares this run's runDigest against it. A difference means the same bundle no longer produces the same run -- the engine, a document, or an input moved. `fluxsim verify` names the component that moved (or says the inputs moved with every component identical). When the move is intended, re-record the baseline with `--update-golden --reason "<why>"`; the reason is written into the golden record, so a baseline can never be moved silently.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2114
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
